conviction_note: The company's own record says the risk is in the guide: two cuts in a row (Jan $54-60m, Mar $52-56m, Aug $48-52m), each sold 14-16%. Q3 consensus of about $12.5m needs +15% sequential growth after Q2 fell in all three segments, against a Q3 that fell sequentially last year. Against that, the stock is 61% off its high and fell about 25% on the uniQure 48-month miss (late Sep), and 15% of shares outstanding are short with 6.6 days to cover. A lean down of p_up 45 on a 16-point absolute move gives -1.6. The sum of the findings (-1.1) is close to it and was not fitted to it.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $12.5m and EPS -$0.27 (Earnings Whispers via finviz preview, 2026-10-20: https://finviz.com/news/405281/clearpoint-neuro-needs-a-revenue-rebound-to-back-its-pivot-toward-drug-delivery). Benzinga lists $13.7m and -$0.26 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CLPT/earnings-forecasts), so the revenue bar is DISPUTED between two sources and findings that rest on it are capped small. The company guide is the firmer anchor: FY2026 revenue $48.0-52.0m (8-K, 2026-08-03: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001285550/000119312526330541/clpt-ex99_1.htm). H1 was $23.0m ($12.1m + $10.9m), so H2 must be $25-29m, about $12.5-14.5m a quarter. The CEO said the guide is '30-plus percent growth in the second half'. H2 2025 was $19.3m ($8.9m + $10.4m), so +30% is $25.1m, the low end of the range.
positioning_check: Short interest was 4,628,991 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 15.2% of 30.5m shares outstanding (not float), with 6.58 days to cover. It was 4,762,256 at 09-30 and has risen from 3.69m in mid-July (equibles FINRA table, https://equibles.com/stocks/clpt/shortinterest). That is a crowded short. Options: skew_25d is null in the baseline, so there is no directional statement from skew. Put/call open interest is 0.20 (call-heavy) on 8,087 contracts. The event-implied move is 17.46% (straddle 22.21% to 11-20) but the ATM spread is 70% of mid, so the implied move is indicative only. The 5-day run-up is +13.19% (from about $9.17 on 10-20 per finviz to $10.47), after a 20-day -14.25%. Price is 61% off its 52-week high.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue lean: hitting the ~$12.5m consensus needs about +15% sequential growth from Q2's $10.9m. Q2 fell sequentially in every segment versus Q1 (biologics $4.8m->$4.0m, neurosurgery $5.9m->$5.6m, capital $1.4m->$1.3m). Last year Q3 fell sequentially ($9.2m->$8.9m). Management guided only 'a return to growth for biologics in H2' and said CAL revenue would not be recognised much this year. A Q3 around $12.0-12.5m, at or slightly under the bar, is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9m missed the ~$12.7-12.8m bar and the guide was cut: -16.25% (2026-08-03). Q4 2025 was pre-announced at $10.4m: +4.89% (2026-01-12). Q3 2025 print: -13.27% (2025-11-06).
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $12.5m (one source) or $13.7m (another) still sits at or above the run-rate the segment data supports. If the market had priced a sequential stall, the street number would be nearer $11.5-12m. Also, the stock would not have run +13% in the five days before the print.
findings.independence: Q1 segment data from a separate document: 8-K 2026-05-13, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001285550/000119312526221596/clpt-ex99_1.htm. FY2025 biologics of $19.0m implies Q3/Q4 2025 biologics of about $4.8m each, so a 'return to growth' only needs about $4.8m+. The arithmetic shares the Q2 8-K with the guidance finding below.

findings.finding: Guidance credibility: FY2026 revenue guidance has been cut twice ($54-60m in Jan, $52-56m in Mar, $48-52m in Aug). With H1 at $23.0m, holding even the low end needs H2 of $25.1m. A Q3 near $12.5m leaves Q4 needing $12.6-16.5m, above any quarter the company has printed. A third cut, or narrowing to the low end, is the line this name has traded on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Mar 2026 cut from $54-60m to $52-56m traded -13.89% (2026-03-17). The Aug 2026 cut to $48-52m traded -16.25% (2026-08-03). The May 2026 print reaffirmed $52-56m and traded +4.76%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is down 61% from its high, but most of the October leg is the uniQure read-through, not ClearPoint's own revenue. If a third cut were priced, a reaffirmation would read as relief. The +13% five-day run-up into the print says the market is not leaning on a cut. The 'high teens to 20%' 2027 baseline from the Q2 call is also exposed if 2026 lands at the low end.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 call transcript: H2 guide is '30-plus percent growth', and 2027 'high teens, if not 20%' (https://www.webull.com/news/15381704337351680). Guide history is in the Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001285550/000119312526330541/clpt-ex99_1.htm), which is shared with the reported-quarter finding.

findings.finding: Partner read-through is already in the price: uniQure's AMT-130 48-month update missed statistical significance on a primary measure. CLPT fell 24% that day (Tue 2026-09-29), and CLPT's own release flow has been silent since 08-03. uniQure's BLA was submitted in late summer with acceptance expected in Q4 2026. On the call, management's commentary on SmartFlow commercial readiness and the 10-15 partner trials expected to enroll in the next 18 months is the swing, from a heavily de-rated base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: CLPT +59% on uniQure 36-month data (Sep 2025). -24% on the 48-month update (2026-09-29). Partner news has moved this stock more than its own prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The downside is priced: about -25% from the 09-30 close of $12.21 (Form 4 reference price) to $9.17 on 10-20. What is not priced is any reassurance on the call, such as the BLA still pending review or partner trial starts. If the market expected reassurance, the stock would not sit near its post-earnings low.
findings.independence: 247wallst 2026-09-30 (QURE -37% to $24.51; BLA submitted late summer, FDA acceptance expected Q4): https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/30/uniqure-stock-crashed-on-its-huntingtons-data-wall-streets-price-target-says-the-selloff-went-too-far/. findings.finding: Liquidity: cash was $29.4m at 06-30 after $15.0m of H1 operating burn, and $50.2m of Oberland notes are outstanding at 11.3% effective. The company can elect a further $25.0m tranche (two $12.5m increments) before 2026-12-31, and the $50m ATM was unused at 06-30. The 10-Q gives no going-concern flag. A Q3 tranche draw or ATM use may be disclosed in the release or the 10-Q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No financing event has coincided with a print in the baseline history. A May 2025 registered direct ($3.3m net) and the Oberland facility came around the May 2025 print (-12.46%), which was not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Asked what the money buys: CAL build-out and clinical-support hiring, against a revenue guide that has been cut twice. That is runway, not a corroborated ramp, though there is no covenant or going-concern pressure. Net, it is a mild negative. An ATM sale disclosed at ~$9-10 would be dilutive, and that is not visible in the price.
findings.independence: Tranche terms from FY2025 10-K / May 2025 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1285550/000119312526111231/clpt-20251231.htm. Management said on the Q2 call that operational burn would decrease in H2 (https://www.webull.com/news/15381704337351680).

findings.finding: Crowded short: 4.63m shares short (15.2% of shares outstanding, 6.58 days to cover) at 10-15, near the 09-30 high of 4.76m. The stock has already squeezed +13% in five sessions into the print. A reaffirmed guide, or Q3 at or above $12.5m, meets a large short base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Up reactions were +4.76% (May 2026), +4.89% (Jan 2026) and +13.09% (Aug 2025). The only non-cut prints were bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is not in the sealed baseline. If the shorts had covered, the 10-15 settlement would show a fall from the 09-30 peak rather than -3%. The run-up may be partial covering already, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: finviz preview 2026-10-20: bearish sentiment up to ~56% from 44% before the last report (https://finviz.com/news/405281/clearpoint-neuro-needs-a-revenue-rebound-to-back-its-pivot-toward-drug-delivery).

findings.finding: CAL (Torrey Pines preclinical lab) was possessed in July 2026, with several SOWs signed including a multi-million-dollar first GLP study due for completion in H1 2027. Management said 'we don't expect to recognize much of the revenue this year', and the guide excludes large CAL studies. New SOW or capacity commentary (stated potential above $60m a year) is upside colour inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 miss was blamed on a slow CAL ramp, with partners reluctant to work in an active construction zone. That print traded -16.25%.
findings.why_not_priced: This sits inside guidance and was told to the market, so it is sized near 0. A quantified CAL backlog would be new information that no estimate carries.
findings.independence: Q2 8-K press release on CAL and the GLP SOW: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001285550/000119312526330541/clpt-ex99_1.htm (same event, a different document).

baseline_tension: Skew is null and put/call OI is call-heavy, so the options give no directional statement to disagree with. The negative guidance lean runs against a crowded short and a +13% five-day run-up, which pulls p_up from about 40 to 45. It agrees with the name's own record of 5 of 8 prints down 12% or more.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed, $12.5m vs $13.7m): the reported-quarter finding that depends on consensus was capped from -2.0 to -1.2. p_up was moved from 43 toward 50.
Rule 7 (crowded short, 15.2% of shares outstanding, 6.6 days to cover): the guidance negative was shrunk from -2.5 to -2.0, applied once. p_up ends at 45.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the money buys runway for CAL and clinical hiring, with no corroborated ramp but no going-concern or covenant flag. Kept negative but cut from -0.5 to -0.3.
Rule 6 (inside the guide): the CAL finding was kept near 0 at +0.3, unchanged.
Rule 8 / core 3b: abs_move_pct kept at 16 (implied 17.5, median 13.2) and not shrunk for sign uncertainty.
